learning_outcomes.text: Students will master the basic concepts of graph theory, several important graph algorithms and optimization algorithms and will be able to do a complex analysis of these algorithms.

syllabus_topics: Basic concepts in graph theory, examples, properties, representation of graphs in a computer, Isomorphism of graphs
Important graph algorithms for searching graphs, finding the optimal spanning tree of a graph, finding the shortest path in a graph, the problem of a business traveler, analysis of these algorithms
Matching and flow in networks; Hall's theorem

assessment_methods.method: Continuous assessment (graded homework, quizzes, activity at recitations, tests)

assessment_rules: The student must obtain at least 55% of points from the semester in order to take the final exam. For the examination, the student must obtain at least 50% of the points from the written part. The approximate scale is A 90%, B 80%, C 70%, D 60%, E 55%.
